official_definition: This Spirit is unaffected by opposing (Color) effects. Also, this Spirit gains every effect of a "Super-Stark" pre-advent card beneath this Spirit, ignoring levels.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Aurora Armor] or [Aurora Armor: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Aurora Armor]", "give [Aurora Armor]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
